admissibility_detail: 3 parameters bound in `termination_by`, but the body of VTask.nthRoot.loop only binds 0 parameters. (Since Lean v4.6.0, the `termination_by` clause no longer expects the function name here.)
extracted_code:
def VTask.nthRoot : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | _, 0 => 0
  | 1, a => a
  | n, a =>
    let rec loop (low high : ℕ) : ℕ :=
      if low > high then high
      else let mid := (low + high) / 2
           let mid_pow := mid ^ n
           if mid_pow == a then mid
           else if mid_pow < a then loop (mid + 1) high
           else loop low (mid - 1)
    termination_by loop low high => high - low
    loop 1 a
